title: Validation of the practicability of logical assessment formula for evaluations with inaccurate ground-truth labels: An application study on tumour segmentation for breast cancer
reasoning: The paper uses 'logical' in the context of formal logic for AI model evaluation (e.g., logical fact narration, logical consistency estimation), not in the sense of moral philosophy, religion, or ethics concerning human behavior or beliefs.
